data.name: Sapan
data.gender_notes: Sapan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sapan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sapna' which means dream or desire. It is also associated with the sky and the sun. In Hindu mythology, the god Indra is often depicted riding on a chariot drawn by horses named Sapanas, which suggests the name's connection to the sky and the sun. The name Sapan carries the meaning “Sky, Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sapan usually hope their child will grow to embody sky, sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
